scope: Targeted RGB contact repair; freeze v3 anatomical and visibility outputs and all 0.8 thresholds
contactCrop: scripts/prepare-grip-contact-v4.py: automatic 1.6x original crop, capped half short dimension without shrinking original box; RGB192; original hand RGB128 unchanged
data: Inherited prior actual-pixel closed labels; every eligible existing open/invalid crop re-reviewed in wider RGB; 119 new automatic crops from 12 existing training videos at fixed transition times. Two explicit review passes; ambiguous inputs masked. No test enters fitting.
roles: Keep original train/validation video roles. Deterministic label-only group partition of 29 validation groups into 15 selection and 14 calibration groups; search 4096 fixed-seed candidate partitions minimizing normalized closed/open/invalid count imbalance. Both sides must have positives, open and invalid negatives.
loss: Binary contact loss with closed mass .5, open/released mass .25, invalid/empty mass .25; equal-video weighting within each subtype; ambiguous/identity-masked inputs excluded. Selection uses equal-class/equal-video binary NLL.
selection: Lowest contact selection NLL across the three candidates. Report frozen-input control and wider/fine-tuned candidates. No test-driven candidate or threshold changes.
calibration: Positive-slope affine calibration on separate calibration groups, class/video-balanced NLL; keep identity calibration if false accepts at 0.8 increase on reviewed negatives.
test: Freeze chosen model, all candidates, protocol, cropper and evaluator before direct 19-video hand review/predictions. Old 32 and 16 videos are regression-only. Fixed2/4/6/8; missing/ambiguous inputs retained; report contact recall, negative false accepts, full-gate accepted correctness and per-video coverage.
storage: Native batches bounded; preserve selected RGB, reviewed crops, models, source videos and evidence. Prune unreferenced native frames after binding reviewed rows.
